manuscript.title: ImmunoTargetNet: A Multimodal Multi-Omics Framework for Immune-Related Target Prioritisation in Psoriasis
manuscript.venue: Frontiers (structured abstract, Frontiers citation style and running footer)
manuscript.supplementary: Tables S1-S13 are referenced but not distributed with the manuscript

claims.statement: The total objective combines a listwise ranking loss with three weighted terms.
Availability-masked attention adds log m to the logits so an unavailable token takes no weight.
claims.implemented_as: additive -inf on unavailable tokens, softmax over available tokens only

claims.statement: The bottleneck projects the pooled state onto the K = 12 immune-programme simplex, the sole route to the ranking head.
claims.implemented_as: mean-pooled attention output through softmax(W_s z_g) over twelve programmes

claims.statement: Edge-type-aware message passing weights each edge type on the simplex over two rounds.
claims.implemented_as: per-type transform and attention, type weights on the simplex, two rounds

claims.statement: A shared layer carries two heads: a relevance head and a readiness head.
claims.implemented_as: z_g = [s_g; h_g], ReLU(W_0 z_g), sigmoid relevance and a tier softmax for readiness

claims.statement: AdamW at a learning rate of 1e-3, batch size 32, 60 epochs, availability-mask dropout 0.2 in training and 0 at inference, early stopping on validation fidelity.
claims.implemented_as: released defaults equal the reported schedule; the smoke file is reduced and labelled

claims.statement: Splits are made by cohort and never by sample; every gene sits in either the training labels or the finalised target set.
claims.implemented_as: one fold per cohort plus disjoint training, validation and held-out label blocks

claims.statement: Pathway holdout masks the curated-target graph edges so holdout scores measure transfer, with a random-subset control matched on the number of genes withheld.
claims.implemented_as: annotation-family edges removed at inference; the control removes the matched gene count at random

claims.statement: Intervals are 95% blocked-bootstrap intervals from 1000 resamples with genes as blocks; comparisons are paired two-tailed t tests with Holm correction inside each family.
claims.implemented_as: gene-block bootstrap plus a Holm step-down carrying the running maximum

claims.statement: Parity is tested with two one-sided tests: the 90% paired-difference interval must sit inside the +-0.010 margin, and overlapping marginal intervals are not the test.
claims.implemented_as: percentile interval of the paired mean difference against the pre-specified band

claims.statement: Readiness is measured by AUPRC, AUROC and expected calibration error against the platform tractability annotations.
claims.implemented_as: clinical-stage tractability buckets form the readiness label; ranking metrics are tie-aware

claims.statement: Attribution faithfulness is the deletion curve difference between removing high- and low-attribution evidence.
claims.implemented_as: the model is re-run with the attributed layers withheld, and the trapezoid area between the two curves is reported

claims.statement: Rank stability is a Kendall tau between the full-panel ranking and the ranking under cohort resampling, pathway holdout and modality dropout, with the fifth percentile beside the mean.
claims.implemented_as: three perturbation families rerun the frozen model; ties are corrected

claims.statement: Cohorts are the eight public expression series, three single-cell resources and three spatial resources of which two profile psoriasis.
claims.implemented_as: accessions, contrast assignment and the reference-only role of the cross-disease resource are declared

claims.statement: The candidate pool is protein-coding genes plus a curated non-coding list on the IL23/IL17 axis.
claims.implemented_as: the pool is the programme corpus intersected with the frozen annotation snapshot

claims.statement: Frozen encoders are an intentional decision: fine-tuning would spoil the pre-trained cell-state and niche representations.
claims.implemented_as: encoders are parameter-free feature maps; only the projection carries weights

claims.statement: The degree-matched control removes the share of a score explained by interaction degree.
claims.implemented_as: ordinary least squares on the standardised degree, with the residual kept as the adjusted score

claims.statement: The shortlist states the missing evidence beside every nomination.
claims.implemented_as: each nomination carries its carrying programme, layer attribution and absent-evidence note

deviations.departure: Eq. (2) writes the additive mask as log m_{g,j} and Algorithm 1 line 10 writes the same term as log M. The release implements the Eq. (2) form, because a positive constant cannot mask anything.
deviations.justification: the two statements cannot both hold; the equation is the one the ranking head depends on.

deviations.departure: Sec. 2.1 gives the availability mask over the L encoder tokens while Algorithm 1 loops j over the M evidence layers. The release indexes the mask over the four evidence layers and derives per-token availability from it.
deviations.justification: a four-layer index keeps the mask and the layer count of Sec. 2.1 consistent, and it is the index space Algorithm 1 actually reads.

deviations.departure: Sec. 2.3 states that the keystone layer is the graph-context embedding, so Algorithm 1's extra append of a context token would duplicate it. The release builds four layer tokens and does not append a fifth.
deviations.justification: four tokens preserve the M = 4 layer budget of Sec. 2.1 and the token count the attention of Eq. (2) is defined over.

deviations.departure: The readiness head is a softmax over readiness tiers while L_read is a binary cross-entropy against tractability annotations. The release fixes the tier count at two, which makes the softmax and the binary cross-entropy the same object.
deviations.justification: the paper does not state the tier count; two is the value that removes the contradiction without changing the printed architecture.

deviations.departure: The curated non-coding list on the IL23/IL17 axis is not published. The release ships a named twelve-gene curation in evidence/programmes.py.
deviations.justification: the pool needs a non-coding member to be the object Sec. 2.1 describes; the curation is declared rather than inferred.

deviations.departure: The twelve programmes are assembled from named gene-set collections of the public immune corpora (GO biological process, Reactome, Hallmark) instead of the unpublished curated list.
deviations.justification: Sec. 2.4 states the programmes were assembled from public immune gene-set collections; the collection identifiers are pinned so the table is rebuildable.

deviations.departure: The eight expression cohorts, the single-cell resources and the spatial resources are public but are not redistributed. The release ships a schema-compatible fixture whose declared construct generates the panel, and takes the programme table, the tractability labels and the typed edges from the frozen keystone snapshot.
deviations.justification: no manuscript table value is claimed from the fixture; every cohort-level value is reported NOT_RUN with the reason recorded.

deviations.departure: The compound perturbation reference of the perturbation layer is not redistributable, so the perturbation-reversal index is part of the declared construct rather than a read of that resource.
deviations.justification: the consistency term keeps its structure and its sign semantics; only the index source departs.

deviations.departure: Interaction edges are read through the platform's interactions schema, whose sourceDatabase field names the originating resource, rather than through a direct download of the interaction network.
deviations.justification: the frozen snapshot records the originating database of every edge, so the edge typing is preserved and auditable.

deviations.departure: The interaction resolver returned no edge during the capture sweep, so the frozen snapshot's interaction family is empty and the typed graph's gene-to-gene structure is absent; the graph keeps its annotation families, which include the pathway nodes of the pathway corpus.
deviations.justification: the empty sweep is recorded in the snapshot itself with the query count and the budget that bounded it, so a reader sees what was collected rather than an assumption; the refresh path repopulates the family.

deviations.departure: The degree control reads a candidate's distinct partner count over all typed families, not interaction edges alone, because the frozen snapshot carries no interaction edge.
deviations.justification: the quantity stays the same kind of thing the manuscript controls for; the definition is recorded here rather than left implicit.

deviations.departure: The manuscript does not report the optimiser weight decay, the warm-up schedule, gradient clipping, the readiness tier count, the model width, the graph-context dimension or the number of attention heads. The release exposes each of them in config with a declared default.
deviations.justification: these are engineering defaults, labelled as such, not reported values.

deviations.departure: The held-out curated target set of 148 targets is not public. The released panel carries a declared target label derived from its own construct.
deviations.justification: the evaluation stack, the statistics and the ranking metrics are exercised end to end; the manuscript's recovery values remain NOT_RUN.
